methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: a set of 3 supplementary KPIs has been formulated, aiming at refining and accelerating the assessment of energy efficiency in the processes within the wine industry.

paper_type.evidence_quote: Just to illustrate a calculation example for the above-defined coefficients, a winery in Northern Italy was selected as case-study.

stage1.notes: Winemaking is outside the closed Level 3B sector list; the paper proposes supplementary input/output-ratio KPIs alongside SEC.

multi_site.evidence_quote: a winery in Northern Italy was selected as case-study.

country_region.evidence_quote: a winery in Northern Italy was selected as case-study.

type_of_organisation.evidence_quote: wine production, i.e. chemical-physical process to transform grapes into wine, involving stages of crushing, fermentation, clarification, stabilization, and maturation.

evidence_quote: Amongst the coefficients that relate non-homogeneous quantities in the winemaking sector, there is also the “energy used to produce a unit of product” (SEC, expressed in kWh·hL-1 of unpacked wine or kWh per 0.75-L-bottle).
Of all the possible coefficients, 3 in particular are proposed (namely: the “winery outsourcing index”, the “overpressure wine share index”, the “wine packaging index”).
